decisions.reason: The system layout and CAD integrate the dispensing mechanism, so the newly specified downward spout orientation must be reflected in that physical layout.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I would also like the spouts to pour downward as shown in the rendering. The drink has a better consistency when the spout directs the pour down rather than along a flat slope.

value_updates.spout_pour_direction_constraint: System layout and CAD must orient the spouts to pour downward as shown in the rendering rather than along a flat slope.

decisions.reason: Changing the mechanical pour direction does not alter the solenoid wiring, motor controls, power supply, or other electrical wiring-plan requirements.
